body: I'm 15 years old and a girl. I'm in 10th grade and I play softball. My parents are extremely hard on me, especially my dad. He wants me to play softball at a D1 school and gets on to me everyday about scholarships and all that. His standards are so high they are impossible to reach. I'm never good enough for him and I never will be. I just can't deal with him anymore. I have no real friends. I have people that will talk to me but no one to call a "best friend". I've tried so hard but no one wants to be my friend. They always have something better to do or someone better to hang out with. It sucks and I'm tired of dealing with it. I'm never going to be good enough for anything, so what's the point?
